people.name: Azariah
people.line: Son of Maaseiah, repairer of Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Binnui
people.line: Levite who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Henadad
people.line: Son of Bani, a Levite who repaired the wall.

translations.web: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.
translations.bsb: After him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah to the angle and the corner,
translations.kjv: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
translations.asv: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another portion, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, and unto the corner.
